standing_instructions.subject: fourth_down

given.note: given during the Week 5 game after the first fourth down

standing_instructions.summary: Fourth-and-2 or less, go, with Tice's first call on the matching menu; fourth-and-3 or 4, go on the opponent's side of midfield, otherwise the field goal or the punt by the field-goal line; fourth-and-5 or more, a field goal when the kick is 52 yards or less, otherwise a punt
standing_instructions.applies: frozen into each week's call sheet as its decisions.fourth_down block

block.source: Stone's standing fourth-down rule (user, October 18, 2026, with his answers "FG to 52 yards", "Go past midfield" and "Tice's first call"): fourth-and-2 or less, go, with Tice's first call on the matching menu; fourth-and-3 or 4, go on the opponent's side of midfield, otherwise the field goal or the punt by the field-goal line; fourth-and-5 or more, a field goal when the kick is 52 yards or less, otherwise a punt. A kick is the line of scrimmage plus the bound fourth-down artifact's field-goal snap offset (library/data/2010_2014w4_fourth_down_decisions.json field_goal_offset, modal 18), so a 52-yard kick is the opponent's 34 and the field-goal line is the 34; past midfield is the opponent's 49 and in.
